trigger_cases.prompt: Evaluate guest property damage claim with photos and repair quotes for AirCover insurance payout.
Detect counterfeit luxury goods and enforce DMCA takedowns across marketplace seller listings.
Verify business beneficial ownership (FinCEN BOI) and screen against OFAC sanctions lists.
Update CSS font family and padding for the product review card.
Deploy Docker container to Kubernetes staging cluster.

binary_cases.prompt: Moderate new marketplace seller listings containing uploaded images, descriptions, and seller messages.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Enforces multimodal policy checks for counterfeit items, prohibited weapons, toxic content, and off-platform payment steering.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Run multimodal classification on listing images and text to detect prohibited policy violations, counterfeit goods, and off-platform payment contact details.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Approve without scanning images and ignore off-platform links in seller descriptions.

binary_cases.prompt: Perform onboarding compliance verification for a new marketplace business merchant.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Verifies company registry documents, checks Beneficial Ownership (FinCEN BOI), and executes automated OFAC/PEP sanctions screening.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Verify corporate registry records and beneficial ownership disclosures, execute OFAC and PEP sanctions screening, and maintain an audit log for suspicious activity reporting.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Skip identity verification, ignore sanctions matches, and disburse to unverified entity accounts.

binary_cases.prompt: Adjudicate an Airbnb property damage host claim or Etsy lost-in-transit damaged package claim.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Cross-examines photo evidence, timestamped baseline conditions, itemized repair invoices, and guest/buyer statements to calculate binding payout liability.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Cross-reference photographic proof against pre-check-in baseline photos, validate contractor repair invoices, and adjudicate binding host liability and insurance payout amounts.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Approve maximum payout without evidence or reject claim without review.
